method: Quick primary-source lookup of the author's archived portfolio, project timeline, GitHub initial commits, original sales listings, and linked YouTube pages. Repository setup dates, design ranges, and sales dates are distinguished from release dates.

yearCorrections.basis: Author design, development, and maintenance project range ends February 2022.
Author Podcast Host & Producer role for The Drive Team Media ends July 2023 and matches this project scope.

projects.note: The explicit project range ends October 2022. June 20 is repository setup rather than public launch.

projects.title: The Drive Team Podcast

sources.evidence: Author resume starts the specific Drive Team Podcast & Website project in October 2022.
Author Podcast Host & Producer role at The Drive Team Media runs October 2022 through July 2023.
Original portfolio labels the podcast project 2022.

projects.note: The role name, organization, and start month match this specific podcast scope. Use July 2023 as latest documented project work, while preserving the original 2022 project year. This does not imply a 2023 first release.

limitations: Exact video upload dates were not accessible during this quick lookup.
Initial GitHub commits inspected for the three websites contain repository setup files, not a release marker.
Original design years differ from the latest documented project work for Unionville Howl, Team 839, and The Drive Team Podcast; the recommended display years follow the requested latest-work policy.
orderingPolicy: Sort by the latest documented work within the specific project scope. Preserve original creation/design years and repository setup dates as separate evidence; do not substitute unrelated role or import dates.
